root_cause.text: The ath12k driver incorrectly enabled WoW offloads on all links (both primary and secondary) in a multi-link connection, but the firmware only supports WoW offloads on the primary link, causing a firmware crash.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds `if (arvif != &arvif->ahvif->deflink) continue;` in multiple WoW functions (`ath12k_wow_cleanup`, `ath12k_wow_set_wakeups`, `ath12k_wow_nlo_cleanup`, `ath12k_wow_arp_ns_offload`, `ath12k_gtk_rekey_offload`) to skip secondary links; the CVE and commit message state that "WCN7850 firmware crashes due to WoW offloads enabled on both primary and secondary links."

agent_logs.root_cause_candidate: The ath12k driver incorrectly enabled WoW offloads on all links (both primary and secondary) in a multi-link connection, but the firmware only supports WoW offloads on the primary link, causing a firmware crash.
agent_logs.evidence_points: The patch adds `if (arvif != &arvif->ahvif->deflink) continue;` in multiple WoW functions (`ath12k_wow_cleanup`, `ath12k_wow_set_wakeups`, `ath12k_wow_nlo_cleanup`, `ath12k_wow_arp_ns_offload`, `ath12k_gtk_rekey_offload`) to skip secondary links; the CVE and commit message state that "WCN7850 firmware crashes due to WoW offloads enabled on both primary and secondary links."

intent_record.intent_summary: In the ath12k WOW cleanup, skip non-default link virtual interfaces to avoid cleanup on secondary links, fixing a potential bug in multi-link operation scenarios.
intent_record.what: Added an if-statement inside the list_for_each_entry loop in ath12k_wow_cleanup that checks if the current arvif is not the default link of its ahvif, and if so, skips the rest of the loop body (including the call to ath12k_wow_vif_cleanup).
intent_record.how: The change causes the function to only call ath12k_wow_vif_cleanup for arvif entries that are the default link of their parent ahvif. Non-default link vifs are skipped, preventing potential double cleanup or incorrect state handling associated with secondary links in a multi-link context.

intent_record.intent_summary: Skip WOW wakeup configuration for non-default links to prevent errors in multi-link operation.
intent_record.what: Added a conditional check inside the list_for_each_entry loop that iterates over arvifs; if the current arvif is not the deflink of its ahvif, the loop continues to the next iteration.
intent_record.how: This change ensures that WOW wakeup setup is only performed on the default link of each virtual interface, skipping non-default links which may not support WOW or could cause errors.

intent_record.intent_summary: Skip non-default link vifs in ath12k_wow_nlo_cleanup to avoid incorrect cleanup on secondary links.
intent_record.what: Added a conditional check that skips the current loop iteration if the arvif is not the deflink of its ahvif.
intent_record.how: This change ensures that only the default link virtual interface (deflink) is processed for WOW NLO cleanup, preventing unintended operations on non-default links.

intent_record.intent_summary: Skip non-default link arvifs when configuring ARP/NS offload to avoid incorrect offload setup.
intent_record.what: Added a guard that continues to the next iteration if the current arvif is not the default link (ahvif->deflink) within the loop over arvifs.
intent_record.how: The loop now skips all arvif entries except the one corresponding to the default link for each ahvif, preventing ARP/NS offload configuration on non-default links.

intent_record.intent_summary: Ensure GTK rekey offload is only applied to the default link in multi-link operation (MLO) scenarios.
intent_record.what: Added a conditional continue statement inside a list_for_each_entry loop in ath12k_gtk_rekey_offload that skips iterations where the current arvif is not the default link (ahvif->deflink).
intent_record.how: The loop now only processes arvif entries that are the default link of their virtual interface; all non-default MLO links are skipped, preventing GTK rekey offload operations on them.

grouping_result.intent: Ensure GTK rekey offload is only applied to the default link in multi-link operation (MLO) scenarios.
Skip non-default link arvifs when configuring ARP/NS offload to avoid incorrect offload setup.

consistency_review.core_intent: Ensure that WOW cleanup, WOW wakeup configuration, and GTK rekey offload are only applied to the default link in multi-link operation scenarios.
Skip non-default link virtual interfaces in various offload handler functions to prevent incorrect operations on secondary links.

relevance_review.reason: The group directly addresses the root cause by ensuring WoW cleanup, WoW wakeup configuration, and GTK rekey offload are only applied to the default link, preventing the firmware crash caused by enabling WoW offloads on secondary links.

The changes explicitly skip non-default link interfaces in WoW-related offload handlers, which prevents enabling WoW offloads on secondary links and thereby directly addresses the firmware crash caused by offloading on multiple links.
